cmvp_certificates.notes: Overall Level 1, Amazon Web Services, Inc. This is AWS's software crypto library (BoringSSL/OpenSSL-derived); per WO-030 it is NOT confirmed to be the AWS CloudHSM hardware module backing the kms-fips.<region>.amazonaws.com endpoints, and must not be cited as the CloudHSM certificate. Vault's seal "awskms" requires an explicit --endpoint/kms-fips override to reach a FIPS-designated AWS KMS endpoint; see docs/fips/kms-hsm-seal-cmvp-certificates.md section 1.

Marvell Semiconductor Inc., Overall Level 3. Historical status (SP 800-56Arev3 transition, superseded by certificate #4399); the NIST certificate page does not publish a sunset date and does not reference Microsoft or Azure by name, so per WO-030 it must not be cited as "the Azure Managed HSM certificate." Vault's seal "azurekeyvault" requires the referenced vault to be a Managed HSM instance or Premium tier with HSM-backed keys; see docs/fips/kms-hsm-seal-cmvp-certificates.md section 2.

Google, LLC, Overall Level 3, hardware SingleChip embodiment. A plausible candidate for the module underlying Cloud HSM / protection_level=HSM keys, but per WO-030 the certificate page does not explicitly bind the module to the Cloud KMS product name, so it is not cited as confirmed. Vault's seal "gcpckms" requires crypto_key to be created with protection_level=HSM; see docs/fips/kms-hsm-seal-cmvp-certificates.md section 3.
